evidence: tests/sentry/integrations/services/test_assignment_source.py:13 defines `test_from_dict_inalid_data`; the test body (lines 14-19) checks invalid input, so the name should read `test_from_dict_invalid_data`. This is a trivial typo fix with no effect on behavior.

src/sentry/integrations/services/assignment_source.py:18 declares `queued: datetime = timezone.now()`. Dataclass defaults are evaluated once, when the class body runs at module import, so every AssignmentSource built without an explicit `queued` (for example via from_integration at lines 21-25, called from src/sentry/integrations/utils/sync.py) gets the process's import timestamp. The fix is `field(default_factory=timezone.now)`; frozen=True does not prevent using it. Impact today is limited: `queued` is only serialized by to_dict and nothing in src reads it yet. Still, the value is wrong, and tests/sentry/integrations/services/test_assignment_source.py:36 only checks that it is not None, so it would not catch this.
